faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Eyang Estate.
faq.q1: How do I book a housing on Eyang Estate?
faq.a1: Simply browse the listings, click on the one you like, and click 'Book' or 'Contact'. You can send a reservation request directly to the owner from the listing page.
faq.a2: Yes, every listing on Eyang Estate is manually verified by our team before being published. We check photos, location, and the provided amenities.
faq.a3: Currently, payments are arranged directly between the student and the owner. We provide a secure messaging system to negotiate and agree on payment terms.
faq.a4: Absolutely! Use the 'Negotiate / Message' button on the listing page to start a conversation with the owner and discuss pricing and conditions.
faq.q5: What happens if the housing doesn't match the listing?
faq.a5: Contact our support team immediately. We take all complaints seriously and will investigate any discrepancy between the listing and the actual housing.
faq.q6: How do I create an owner account?
faq.a6: Click 'Sign up' and select 'Owner' as your account type. Once registered, you can publish your listings from your dashboard.
